title: Canadian strategic-technology investor candidates

selectedGap.reason: The initial government-innovation-office gap is saturated in the live corpus. This fallback expands a still-shallow investor-funder layer with evidence-backed Canadian venture-capital profiles that finance strategic technology sectors.

guardrailNotes: Private review material only. No candidate is accepted, published, or written to canonical organization records by this workflow.
Official investor mandates and portfolios are evidence anchors. Government, association, conference, and social surfaces remain discovery context unless separately cited as durable evidence.
Investment focus is not evidence of a defence contract, procurement relationship, customer relationship, government endorsement, or classified demand.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Mistral Venture Partners is recommended for private review because its official material establishes a Canadian venture-capital role, a concrete investment mandate, and a public portfolio relationship relevant to the national technology ecosystem. Its technology emphasis can improve capital-ecosystem visibility around strategic industrial, software, AI, cyber, climate, or advanced-manufacturing sectors without overstating any defence relationship. The record is intentionally amber: the mandate and portfolio are durable public evidence, while the city-level map placement should remain reviewer-confirmed before publication.
